promptRecipes.promptFormula: Thick friendly closed jet-black ink outlines, large open coloring zones, simplified background clutter, 100% pure white paper, zero gray halftone shading.
promptRecipes.proTip: Use 3:4 portrait or 4:3 landscape so the output fits US Letter (8.5x11) and A4 printer sheets with clean margins.

promptRecipes.promptFormula: Fine uniform black technical outlines with hollow unfilled lettering, floral leaf contours, and crisp paving geometry on pure solid white.
promptRecipes.proTip: Choose Studio Pro or export at 2K/4K when converting dense architecture so bricks and petals do not merge together.

promptRecipes.promptFormula: Warm storybook black ink contours capturing genuine smile lines and clothing seams cleanly without harsh black face shadows.
promptRecipes.proTip: Keep reference strength around 0.75 on human faces—higher values may over-simplify eye likeness.

promptRecipes.promptFormula: Bold closed geometric mosaic lead-lines framing the main subject on solid #FFFFFF white, ready for bright watercolor markers.
promptRecipes.proTip: Ideal for photos with messy backgrounds, turning distracting foliage into structured stained-glass panes.

landingPages.h1: Photo to Sketch & Line Art — Turn Pictures into Drawings

promptRecipes.promptFormula: Hand-drawn 2B and 4B graphite pencil portrait on warm cream sketchbook paper, directional diagonal hatching, soft blended shadows, raw pencil grain.
promptRecipes.proTip: Keep strength between 0.65 and 0.75 on close-up portraits so irises and lip corners stay 100% faithful while paper grain emerges naturally.

promptRecipes.promptFormula: Technical black waterproof fineliner ink drawing on pure white Bristol board, straight architectural edges, subtle foliage stippling, crisp monochrome.
promptRecipes.proTip: Works best on daytime exterior photos with crisp sunlit shadows; avoid heavy mist so window mullions remain razor sharp.

promptRecipes.promptFormula: Rich expressive willow charcoal drawing on heavy tooth rag paper, deep velvety shadows, soft tortillon smudges, bright white chalk eye catchlights.
promptRecipes.proTip: Side-lit photographs produce the strongest chiaroscuro tonal range when rendered in charcoal.

promptRecipes.promptFormula: Modern single-weight jet-black ink contour line art on bright white background, zero shading gradients, clean editorial illustration.
promptRecipes.proTip: Push strength to 0.80+ when converting cluttered backgrounds into ultra-clean vector-like contours.
